title: FGC 636: Outdoor Decorative Appliances
officialText:
636.1 General.

Permanently fixed-in-place outdoor decorative appliances shall be tested in accordance with ANSI Z21.97/CSA 2.41 and shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
